emerging_watch: Watch for Gold Miners (XGD.TO) to close the momentum gap with Base Metals. A confirmed handoff would be signaled if XGD.TO outperforms XBM.TO by more than 5% over any rolling 10-day window, combined with sustained breadth above 0.8 for Gold Miners.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper displays strong, broad-based momentum with no crowding. The absolute-trend gate, the only validated edge, has historically reduced drawdown risk for eligible themes. While the mixed Hurst tag signals the trend is not firmly persistent, the breadth and durability argue for continued leadership in the resource-centric TSX over a tactical horizon, provided no macro shock disrupts commodities.
theses.dissent: Copper and base metals are highly cyclical; any sudden global growth scare, especially from China, could quickly unwind momentum. The mixed Hurst tag suggests the trend may not be robust enough to withstand a shock.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 3% over the next 20 trading days.
